mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate indicates a monetary policy response to a weakening labor market, which typically precedes a recession and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing during labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market recovery (HOUST > 600.0) combined with strong retail sales (RSAFS > 350000) indicates robust consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 600.0 and RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of real GDP (GDPC1 < 13000.0) indicates a weak economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 13000.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of high labor market slack (UNRATE > 9.0%), a sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS > 130000.0) signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0 and PAYEMS > 130000.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, which prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.
